description: This Java class 'ImagesApiResource' provides REST API endpoints for managing images related to entities (such as clients and staff), including uploading, retrieving, updating, and deleting images. It handles multipart form uploads, base64 encoded images, image resizing, and content serving with proper media types.

classes.name: ImagesApiResource
classes.description: REST API resource for managing images associated with entities such as clients and staff. Handles upload, retrieval, update, and deletion of images with support for multipart and Base64 encoded images, including resizing and content serving.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Handles multipart form uploads to add a new image for a specified entity.

methods.name: addNewClientImage
methods.description: Handles base64 encoded image data uploads to add a new image for a specified entity.

methods.name: retrieveImage
methods.description: Retrieves an image for a given entity, supporting resizing and different output formats (Base64 or binary).

methods.name: updateClientImage
methods.description: Updates an existing image with a multipart form upload.

methods.name: updateClientImage
methods.description: Updates an existing image with base64 encoded data.

methods.name: deleteClientImage
methods.description: Deletes an image associated with the given entity.
